verdict.rationale: Community evidence highlights Datadog's tagging-based correlation and one-click field-to-search-dimension feature (comm-3, comm-14), suggesting facet-like filtering on arbitrary fields such as user id or request id without pre-defined indexes. However, no evidence explicitly confirms high-cardinality grouping/filtering performance or behavior at scale, nor whether pre-aggregation is truly unnecessary for logs/traces with high-cardinality tags. missing for 10: first-party docs on high-cardinality tag/facet handling, benchmarks or docs confirming no indexing/pre-aggregation needed, independent verification of performance at scale for user_id/request_id style fields.
